## Summary
Reviewed head b410ebc4. The one-line guard change (`Number.isFinite(contextWindow)` replacing `typeof === 'number'`) is correct and meets the issue 7771 acceptance: NaN and Infinity now return `false`, and the rows and the override map are untouched because the function returns before the map. The new test in `models.test.js` goes red against the old guard (verified in a scratch copy: `expected: false, actual: true`). PR title, body and commit message have no hash-number references, carry `Trial-Closes: 7771`, and contain no attribution.

## Strengths
- Minimal, correctly placed fix at the shared surface instead of a third per-caller guard.
- New test checks rows byte-identical and, via a later refresh, that no override was recorded.
- Stale comment inside `updateContextWindow` was updated to match.

## Critical
1. **The existing NaN learned-map test no longer covers the guard it was written for.** `models-overlay-reload.test.js` (the "NaN ratchet is never written into the learned map" test) existed to prove the inner `Number.isInteger(contextWindow) && contextWindow > 0` check in `models.js` (~line 1574) keeps bad values out of `learnedContextWindows`. With the top-level guard now rejecting NaN, that test returns before ever reaching the inner check. Mutation evidence in a scratch copy with the new guard: deleting `&& Number.isInteger(contextWindow) && contextWindow > 0` from the inner condition leaves all 175 tests green. Before this PR the same mutant was killed by this test. The inner check is still live behavior: a fractional window such as 272000.5 passes the new top-level guard, would be written to the learned map and the cache file, and is refused on load (read side requires integers). Nothing tests that. Fix: add a test in the same describe block: declaration-only row, `updateContextWindow('my-model', 272000.5)`, `saveCache`, assert `learnedContextWindows` has no `my-model`. I added exactly that test to a scratch copy: it passes on the PR head and goes red when the inner integer check is removed.

## Suggestions
- FOLD: `codex-app-server-session.js` ~line 1536 doc comment ("`registry.updateContextWindow` tests `typeof === 'number' && > 0`, which NaN passes ... it would then write NaN") is now false. Reword it to say the call-site `Number.isFinite` is defence in depth. Similarly the read-side comment at `models.js` ~line 468 says the input guard admits NaN; make it past tense.
- DEFER (optional): the `Number.isFinite` guards at the two callers are now redundant with the shared guard; leave them, they are harmless, but they could be dropped later.

## Nitpicks
- The new test iterates NaN and Infinity in one loop; a negative-Infinity case is covered by `<= 0` already, so no change needed.

## Verdict
Request Changes. Single blocker: restore coverage of the inner learned-map integer check (Critical 1). Everything else is sound.
